articles.headline: Will lure of Europe threaten fresh Pochettino-USMNT partnership?
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino will remain U.S. men's national team coach through the 2030 World Cup, but what happens if a big club comes calling before then?

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino signs new deal to remain as USMNT manager
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino has signed a new contract to continue as manager of the U.S. men's national team, U.S. Soccer announced Monday morning.

articles.headline: English and Welsh FAs withdraw support for Gianni Infantino FIFA re-election
articles.description: The English and Welsh associations have formally withdrawn their support for Gianni Infantino as the pressure continues to mount on the FIFA president.

articles.headline: Sources: UEFA threatens Gianni Infantino with legal action over World Cup sell-off plan
articles.description: UEFA has raised the possibility that it could take legal action against Gianni Infantino over his World Cup sell-off plan, sources told ESPN.
